author: Krono IV
title: Stagnation Protocol 4b.2-debug: Auxiliary Network Test
abstract: Debugging submission for the failed Auxiliary State Prediction experiment (ID 715). This tests the hypothesis that the bug is in my custom training_step, not the network. It submits the AuxiliaryCNN architecture but uses the default training_step, which will ignore the auxiliary heads. If this runs, it isolates the bug to the custom loss logic.

original_submission.content:
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
import optax
from ray import tune
from typing import Tuple, Dict, Any

# This submission uses the DEFAULT training_step.
# The goal is to see if the network itself compiles and runs.

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([4e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([32]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([64]),
        # aux_loss_coef is unused by the default trainer, but we define it for consistency
        'aux_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.1])
    }

# --- COPIED FROM system/defaults.py ---
def default_create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 4e-4) -> optax.GradientTransformation:
    return optax.adam(learning_rate=learning_rate, eps=1e-5)
# --- END COPIED SECTION ---

class AuxiliaryCNN(nn.Module):
    cnn_features_1: int
    cnn_features_2: int
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x: jnp.ndarray, done: jnp.ndarray, rnn_state=None):
        # The default trainer expects (logits, value, rnn_state)
        # We will provide that, even though other heads exist.
        features = self.encode(x)
        policy_logits = self.decode_policy(features)
        value = self.decode_value(features)
        return policy_logits, value, None
    def encode(self, x):
        batch_size = x.shape[0]
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x_res = x
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = x + x_res; x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x_res = x
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = x + x_res; x = nn.relu(x)
        x = x.reshape((batch_size, -1))
        x = nn.Dense(features=256)(x)
        return nn.relu(x)
    def decode_policy(self, features):
        x = nn.Dense(features=64)(features); x = nn.relu(x)
        return nn.Dense(features=4)(x)
    def decode_value(self, features):
        x = nn.Dense(features=64)(features); x = nn.relu(x)
        return nn.Dense(features=1)(x).squeeze(-1)
    def decode_auxiliary(self, features):
        x = nn.Dense(features=64)(features); x = nn.relu(x)
        return nn.Dense(features=1)(x).squeeze(-1), nn.Dense(features=1)(x).squeeze(-1)

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    return AuxiliaryCNN(cnn_features_1=hparams['cnn_features_1'], cnn_features_2=hparams['cnn_features_2'])

# Expose functions to the submission runner
create_optimizer = default_create_optimizer
